function: Pattern-recognition receptor kinase that confers race-specific resistance to Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae (bacterial leaf blight) by recognizing a conserved bacterial peptide (RaxX) and activating downstream immune signaling.
Cytoplasmic NBS-LRR (nucleotide-binding site leucine-rich repeat) immune receptor that recognizes the AVR-Pita effector from Magnaporthe oryzae and triggers a resistance response against rice blast.
Pathogenesis-related (PR-10 family) protein induced during general fungal/abiotic stress responses in rice; used in prior literature as a marker of activated defense signaling.
Salicylic-acid-associated pathogenesis-related protein commonly upregulated during fungal and stress-related defense responses in rice leaves.
Stress-responsive dehydrin expressed at baseline/low levels under normal healthy growth conditions; used here as a reference protein for comparison against stress-induced conditions.
